type: human intent review gate (judgment gate, not automation gate)

control_fact.summary: permissionless LiquidityManager.moveLiquidity() + donation-inflatable end-criterion gate => an external donor can force lifecycle graduation early by self-funding the full threshold
control_fact.runtime_facts: self-funded (cost = gate amount); profit-less (attacker recoups 0; donation -> agent-owned LP); no funds stuck/stolen; irreversible (monotonic stage + permanent kill)

checks.3_forced_migration_harm: fees conserved + manipulation net-loss; BUT forces premature agent-alive + governance-active + irreversible liquidity move; NO funds stuck/stolen
checks.4_cost_recoverable_indirectly: not directly; possible indirect via early governance activation (UNPROVEN, = C2)
checks.5_cost_non_credible: UNKNOWN/configurable (effective bar = min of OR-ed targets; global target owner-mutable)
checks.7_owner_mitigation_after: NONE (monotonic Agent.setStage; permanent BootstrapPool.killed); only pre-set threshold

evidence.readme_intent: README.md:73 'intended to move liquidity ... given certain conditions are met'; 'Documentation: N/A'
evidence.readme_attack_focus: README.md:215-216 'Graduation of agents and transfer of LP to Fraxswap' + 'funds getting stuck or stolen' (severity bar)
evidence.agent_alive_gate: Agent.sol:41-43 onlyWhenAlive -> NotAlive while stage==0; Agent.sol:106 setStage monotonic (if _stage>stage)

rationale: real self-funded/profit-less/irreversible lifecycle-control primitive that satisfies the literal documented condition, violates no documented fair-launch promise, and causes no funds-stuck/stolen (argues acceptable); but forces premature graduation with no owner mitigation in a team-flagged attack area (graduation), and acceptability hinges on two unresolved context items

missing_context.C1_cost_credibility: intended threshold magnitude; effective bar = min of two OR-ed, owner-mutable targets
missing_context.C2_downstream_harm: does premature agent-alive + early governance enable a follow-on attack (governance capture / premature agent operation)? currently unproven

escalation_map.to_ACCEPTABLE_SELF_FUNDED_CONTROL: C1 high/credible cost AND C2 no downstream harm AND team confirms threshold-only graduation intended
escalation_map.to_REPORT_CANDIDATE_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW: C1 cheap/owner-lowerable bar OR C2 demonstrated downstream consequence
escalation_map.to_INTENDED_BEHAVIOR: explicit protocol statement that donation-funded graduation is by design
